title: Mexico, Duke's chauffeur and friend
summary: Tizol remembers Mexico as Duke's driver and long-time companion who was sometimes ill in Los Angeles.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yeah. When you were in New York
with Duke, did you ever go to Mexico's?
Mexico's. Do you remember Mexico's, a club in New York?
That's when what's her name, when Duke was at a downtown club with a small group then.
Did you know Mexico when he lived down here?
Mexico used to take clothes and stuff like that, and drive them around.

Because I know, when Mexico lived out here, he had tuberculosis or something and he was in the Veterans Hospital. Duke used to get him out of the hospital, and he would stay with Duke at the Watkins Hotel.
Oh? I don't remember that. But he was with Duke almost all the time.
Yeah, he used to drive Duke around out here.
He used to drive Duke Ellington.
Yeah. I know Duke used to check him out, because I guess Mexico was broke or something, so Duke would sign for him and say he would be responsible for him, and
he would stay at the Watkins with Duke.
Oh yeah, they were old friends.
Yeah, from way back in New York in the early days.
